description: Source code for a multi-threaded proxy resolver implementation in Chromium, including classes for managing worker threads, jobs, and proxy resolution requests.

classes.name: Executor
classes.description: Manages a worker thread and a synchronous proxy resolver for handling proxy requests.

classes.name: MultiThreadedProxyResolver
classes.description: Implements an asynchronous proxy resolver that manages multiple executor threads.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Base class for jobs executed on worker threads, including proxy resolution tasks.

classes.name: CreateResolverJob
classes.description: Job that creates a proxy resolver on a worker thread.

classes.name: GetProxyForURLJob
classes.description: Job that performs proxy resolution for a specific URL.

classes.name: RequestImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a proxy resolution request.

methods.name: Executor::StartJob
methods.description: Starts a job on the executor's thread.

methods.name: Executor::Destroy
methods.description: Cleans up the executor, cancels jobs, and joins the thread.

methods.name: MultiThreadedProxyResolver::GetProxyForURL
methods.description: Initiates a proxy resolution request for a URL.

methods.name: MultiThreadedProxyResolver::AddNewExecutor
methods.description: Creates and starts a new executor thread.

methods.name: MultiThreadedProxyResolver::OnExecutorReady
methods.description: Handles an executor becoming available to run a new job.
